channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Maurice Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Maurice Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Maurice Williams
item.description:
Green plans on hosting the camp again next offseason.

“Mo Williams was a solid dude who always looked out for the young guys,”

Draymond Green on Maurice Williams, Aug 8, 2018. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Lavoy Allen on Maurice Williams
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Lavoy Allen on Mo Williams' 52 point game:

“It said 19-for-33 on the stat sheet but…it seemed like he ain’t miss 14 shots.”

Lavoy Allen on Maurice Williams, Jan 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Troy Daniels on Maurice Williams
item.description:
Mark Berman:Troy Daniels on Mo Williams admitting he invented controversy to create a distraction for Troy:

“That's respect from a vet. It makes me kind of relevant. It makes me feel good. I'm just appreciative to be talked about on NBA Gametime.”

Troy Daniels on Maurice Williams, May 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Maurice Williams
item.description:
#Blazers GDamian Lillard on adding Mo Williams via text:

“It's a great pickup for us. It's making us a better team.”

Damian Lillard on Maurice Williams, Aug 7, 2013. Source: Twitter @ChrisBHaynes.
